description: The resource records agreements under Montréal’s mixed-metropolis housing regulation 20-041, which seeks to improve social, affordable and family housing supply. The description states that an agreement is required with permit applications from April 2021. CSV, GeoJSON and ZIP descriptors are listed as representations of the same agreements. Native time-span metadata begins in March 2020 and ends in February 2024, so the earlier metadata start is preserved without interpreting it as the regulation’s effective date. Agreements do not establish completed units or current compliance. The licence label says Creative Commons 4.0 and its URL identifies the CC-BY section; legal terms and file contents were not fetched. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: City of Montreal. Licence: Creative Commons 4.0; source licence URL identifies CC-BY. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
